subject: literacy
concept: Writing a persuasive piece that anticipates and responds to a counterargument
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student states their argument, then states the strongest opposing point, then responds to it
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a counterargument to the best response addressing it
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph that states a claim, addresses a counterargument, and responds to it

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph includes a genuine counterargument and a real response to it, not just a restated claim
misconception_flags: states a weak, easily dismissed counterargument instead of the strongest real opposing point

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
